lines.text: The speaker's heart is faint, and the people cry from far away asking whether the LORD is no longer in Zion.
The speaker asks whether there is no balm in Bethel and no physician there.
The speaker wishes for a fountain of tears, and also for a traveler's lodge in the wilderness to leave his faithless people.
The LORD of Hosts says He will bring them home from far away and test them.

wrong_details.wrong: bring them home from far away

lines.text: The LORD will make Jerusalem a heap of rubble and the cities of Judah a desolation without inhabitant.
